svg.text: Android’s own notification shade, pulled down from the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: top of the screen. UMSH supplies only the notifications

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: in it and has no list of its own. Messages use

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: MessagingStyle with a conversation shortcut, so they

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: sit in Android’s Conversations section. A direct chat

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: is titled by the peer, with the peer’s canonical avatar

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: as its Person icon; a channel is a group conversation

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: titled by the channel, each line naming its sender,

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: with the channel badge as its icon.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Actions: Reply (inline) and Mark as read. Posted only

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: after the message is stored, and not for the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: conversation on screen.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Reply opens the system’s inline field. A reply sends

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: like the composer would: if the radio cannot send, the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: reply is kept as the conversation’s draft and a notice

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: says so (last board).

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: A catalog, not a screen: there is only ever one radio

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: notification, and it changes in place as the radio’s

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: state changes.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: The foreground service’s notification, in the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: low-importance Radio connection channel, so it is

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: silent and sits under Silent. It always carries the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: power state, worded as in the guidelines, with the same

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: radio control glyphs at the end. Tap opens Radio

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Detail.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Waiting is the fallback if Android cannot wake the app

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: when the radio returns. Disconnect and Stop end the

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: service and are worded as on Radio Detail.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Message notifications are private, with a public

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: version reading “New message” and “Contents hidden”.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: The system’s lock screen setting chooses between them,

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: and the in-app option the guidelines ask for (Settings,

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: batch 5) forces the public one. iOS has no such option

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: yet. The radio notification is not sensitive and shows

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: in full.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: The iOS notices, unchanged in wording: a message that

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: went unconfirmed or undeliverable while nobody was

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: looking, a reply from a notification that could not be

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', system-ui, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: sent, and a node the user asked to be told about.
